# Jv.

Techs, math, physics, and life.

> Embrace what the age brings. Some are to be pursued, others let go.
> Do not seek all answers amid exploration. Savor the journey,
> which is what life ought to be.

Essays are longform and published when ready, not on a schedule.
The archive lists everything; the RSS feed carries full text.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://sve.moe/): Latest issue and featured essays
- [About](https://sve.moe/about): Who am I.(I'm Jysve, abbr."Jv". "Jv." is also site's name)
- [Archive](https://sve.moe/blog): All essays, searchable, filterable by category and tag
- [RSS feed](https://sve.moe/rss.xml): Full-text feed of every published piece

## Contributors

- [Authors](https://sve.moe/about/): Owner and who did press their essays on the site.
